verdict.rationale: LibreOffice documents a headless --convert-to pipeline (for example to writer_pdf_Export) and broad import/export filters for docx, pptx, xlsm, Pages, PageMaker and EPUB. Hands-on reports say old Word documents rendered correctly when Office 365 misformatted them, and that it is used in Docker to generate PDFs from templates. However, nothing explicitly confirms that fonts, images and tables survive conversion, and comparative claims of weaker MS Office compatibility are not concrete failures, so they do not create a dispute. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of conversion fidelity guarantees, explicit evidence that fonts/images/tables are preserved, independent fidelity testing across formats.

support.subject: As a power user, document conversion preserves layout, fonts, images, and tables rather than flattening them

citations.quote: Also runs it in Docker to generate PDFs from templates and normalize document formats.
